section_results.title: Purpose
section_results.original_content: The purpose of this policy is to define a standardized safety expectation for shutting down fuel flow valves during the unloading of gasoline from a tanker truck into underground storage tanks at a gas station. This policy aims to reduce the risk of spills, fires, environmental impact, equipment damage, and personal injury by ensuring valve shutdown activities are performed safely, consistently, and by authorized personnel.

section_results.title: Description
section_results.original_content:
Fuel unloading operations involve transferring gasoline from a tanker truck to a gas station’s storage tanks using designated piping, hoses, and control valves. Valve shutdown is a critical safety control used to stop fuel flow during normal completion of unloading, abnormal operating conditions, or emergency situations.
This policy applies to all field workers, tanker drivers, site operators, and supervisors involved in fuel delivery and unloading activities. Only personnel who are trained and authorized may perform or direct valve shutdown actions.

section_results.title: Instructions
section_results.original_content:
Field workers must comply with the following high-level instructions when performing valve shutdown activities:
Ensure you are trained, authorized, and familiar with site-specific fuel unloading procedures before beginning work.
Confirm that unloading is complete or that a shutdown is required due to unsafe or abnormal conditions.
Communicate with the site operator, supervisor, and tanker driver before initiating a valve shutdown, following established communication protocols.
Execute valve shutdown activities strictly in accordance with approved site-specific SOPs.
Apply required safety controls such as lockout/tagout, barriers, or warning signage when specified.
Verify that fuel flow has stopped and observe the area for leaks, spills, or other hazards.
Report completion of the shutdown and any issues identified through required documentation and reporting channels.
Stop work immediately and escalate to supervision or emergency response if uncertainty or unsafe conditions exist.

section_results.title: Field Worker / Tanker Driver
section_results.original_content:
Follow this policy and all site-specific SOPs during fuel unloading and valve shutdown activities.
Perform valve shutdown actions only if trained and authorized.
Maintain situational awareness and immediately report unsafe conditions, spills, or equipment issues.

section_results.title: Site Operator
section_results.original_content:
Ensure unloading areas are prepared and safe prior to delivery operations.
Coordinate with tanker drivers and field workers during unloading and shutdown activities.
Support emergency response actions when required.

section_results.title: Supervisor / Manager
section_results.original_content:
Ensure personnel are properly trained, authorized, and competent.
Verify compliance with this policy and site-specific procedures.
Investigate incidents, near misses, or policy deviations and ensure corrective actions are implemented.

section_results.title: Policy Control and Compliance
section_results.original_content:
Compliance with this policy is mandatory. Failure to follow this policy may result in disciplinary action, retraining, or removal from authorized duties, in accordance with company policies.
This policy is supported by site-specific SOPs, training programs, and regulatory requirements including applicable safety, environmental, and transportation regulations. Supervisors are responsible for monitoring compliance through audits, observations, and incident reviews.
This policy shall be reviewed periodically and updated as necessary to reflect changes in regulations, equipment, or operational practices.
